note: Which workspace files an update may replace. Only files that are in the payload, match `system` (or `sections`) and match no `owner` pattern are managed, by three-way comparison against the rendered base of the last install or update: unchanged since the base -> take the new version (or delete it when the new payload drops it); changed -> keep it, write <file>.new and report it. `sections` files are managed only between <!-- v-distro:begin <id> --> and <!-- v-distro:end <id> -->; text outside the markers belongs to the owner. A file installed before it had markers is compared as a whole file once. Globs: `*` (no slash) and `**`. Owner wins over system.
schedules: After the files, run `python3 scripts/v-schedule.py install --base <the old schedules.json>` as the service user in the agent's environment: it adds missing system jobs, updates or removes jobs still exactly as the old file defined them, and reports jobs the owner changed (ownerChanged). Without a recorded owner it exits 1: skip and report.
